messages:
maya: Quick sync — ran llm.int8 (bitsandbytes) weight-only on llama-2-13b today, comparing against fp16 baseline and GPTQ/AWQ. Short summary: memory ~halved, throughput +2.1x, MMLU delta -1.9 points absolute, perplexity +0.6. Details below.

sam: Nice — what quant scheme did you use? nf4/llm.int8? per-channel vs per-tensor?

maya: used bitsandbytes llm.int8 config with NF4-like packing (bnb weight-only); huggingface transformers + accelerate stack. bnb ver ~0.39. Ran with disabled attention-quant for one run to sanity-check. Example run: 
```
python run_eval.py --model ./llama-2-13b --quantize llm.int8 --bnb-nf4 True --batch 8 --seq-len 2048
```

priya: uploaded eval outputs to S3: s3://redwood-evals/1767890123_int8_bnb_eval.csv — contains MMLU, HellaSwag, LAMBADA, perplexities. Baselines: fp16 MMLU=74.3, INT8(Maybe bnb) MMLU=72.4 (delta -1.9). PPL fp16=6.8 -> int8=7.4.

jon: latency / throughput numbers? single-card or multi?

maya: single A100-40GB (dedicated test node): median token latency fp16=115ms, int8=86ms. Throughput (batch16): fp16 ~90 tok/s -> int8 ~195 tok/s. Peak mem (model+kv) fp16=43GB -> int8=24GB. So fits on a single 40GB now with room for larger cache.

sam: how did GPTQ/AWQ compare on the same eval set?

maya: GPTQ-4bit (our current script) had MMLU=71.0, PPL~8.0 — better memory (model ~20GB) but larger quality delta and occasional token-level degradation on LM evals. AWQ preliminary looked similar to GPTQ. Observational: GPTQ produced more incoherent long-form completions in summarization tasks.

priya: any ablations? per-layer fallback, keep attn/ffn fp16?

maya: ran partial-quant: keep attention layers fp16, quantize rest -> MMLU improved to 73.3, PPL 7.1, latency ~95ms. So attention layers seem sensitive. Plan to try: 1) attention fp16 + weight-only int8 rest, 2) per-channel scale recalibration, 3) KV cache in fp16.

eval-bot: automated-eval results: quality_regression=true; regression_score=1.9; affected_tasks=["MMLU","LAMBADA"]; severity=low-medium; suggested_action="canary rollout with 5% traffic, monitor per-route loss and auto-fallback to fp16".

jon: propose config for Redwood Dedicated canary: route quantized model to canary pool with 5% traffic, add eval-hook to compute MMLU/LM-eval on production prompts, and enable fallback if route-specific metric delta >1.0 points.

sam: add a prompt-set small-batch that runs every deploy and a synthetic adversarial set for long-form hallucination checks.

maya: agreed. Next steps: re-run llm.int8 with attention fp16, post updated CSV by EOD, and attach a lightweight canary config (will include fallbacks). Also pushing an internal note on expected cost reduction: ~35-45% per-token infra cost savings at current throughput due to GPU utilization improvements.

priya: thanks — please tag eng-runtime and eng-sre in the canary PR so we can get infra reserved. :thumbsup:
